home.title: Dance Point Luboń
home.text_1: A dance school where children, teenagers and adults can develop their dance skills and spend their free time actively and creatively.
home.text_2: Dance Point Luboń is more than a dance school — it is a community, energy and a place to grow. Join us and discover how dance can change your life.

prices.title: Prices and passes

discounts.studentNote: Show a valid student ID when purchasing.
discounts.familyNote: When purchasing at least two passes together.

faq.validityQuestion: How long is a monthly pass valid?
faq.validityAnswer: 30 calendar days from the first visit. Unlimited and 12-class passes can be frozen once for up to three days.
faq.classesQuestion: Do passes work across all classes?
faq.classesAnswer: Yes, unless a class is marked as a special workshop. Kids passes are valid for kids groups only.

prices.ctaNote: Not sure which pass to choose? Book a trial lesson and we will help you decide.

rent.title: Studio rental
rent.description: The halls are available for private lessons, training, rehearsals and events. Night hours and special events may have different rates. Contact us for a custom quote.
